name: SeerAttention-style
tagline: Learn which historical blocks deserve attention.
description: Token queries score pooled keys from 64-token blocks. An internal attention teacher supervises the learned block gate. This is a from-scratch SeerAttention-style adaptation.
paperTitle: SeerAttention: Learning Intrinsic Sparse Attention in Your LLMs
mechanism: 64-token historical blocks and a 256-token selection budget
An internal teacher trains the block gate with a KL objective
Dense burn-in precedes sparse language modeling; the current tail remains visible
limitations: Does not reproduce the original pooled-query AttnGate network or its complete training recipe.
